events.text: My own simulation of the plan works, so now I'm checking it against the real rules.

I've solved the level: the official checker reports the sequence below as won after 116 moves, using 1 of the 40 rule-tool calls.

The bridge at (11,15)–(11,16) only becomes walkable once every monster is dead. The warrior can't reach the goblins on the outer islands, so he pushes the four dragons around the middle island and lines them up to breathe across the water:

1. **West-facing dragon (14,9):** pushed north to row 8, which kills the goblin at (3,8). It is then parked at (12,7).
2. **East-facing dragon (10,13):** pushed east and then north up column 12, killing the right-island goblins in rows 12, 10 and 8. It ends at (12,8), just below the parked dragon.
3. **South-facing dragon (8,10):** pushed down to row 14 and along it, killing the bottom-island goblins in columns 9, 12, 14 and then 7. It is then pushed into the water to drown.
4. **North-facing dragon (10,11):** pushed along row 11, killing the top-island goblins in columns 8, 11 and 14. As it passes column 12, the east-facing dragon above it takes its breath and dies. That protects the parked west-facing dragon, which would otherwise have been killed.
5. **West-facing dragon again:** pushed down column 12, killing the left-island goblins in rows 10, 12 and 14, then drowned.
6. **Last dragon:** the north-facing dragon is drowned, which closes the bridge. The warrior walks down column 11 to the door at (11,18).
